title: Advance through a scanned field
statement: Let $m>0$, let $����$, $a_0$, and $����$ be fixed, and let $j$ be an index less than $m$. Let $a,b$ be states, let $w$ be a word, and let $d$ be a configuration in the forward scan state with state value $a$. Suppose tape $0$, relative to its head, contains the buffer for $w$ at every integer position from $-1$ through $|w|$. Suppose the phase redirect from scanning field $j$ in the completed state obtained by folding $w$ from $a$ leads to the skip phase carrying $b$, and that the completed skip phase carrying $b$ redirects to a phase-control state $q$. After $3|w|+5$ steps of the round machine, the configuration is the original one with tape $0$'s head advanced by $|w|+1$, and with state mapped to $q$. At every earlier time $u<3|w|+5$, its state is neither the read state with no stored Boolean value nor the exit state.
